answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: each new identity's rewards stay locked for 30 epochs, and any attestation it signs in that window can be slashed if a later jury flags it. A farmer running 500 accounts must keep every kernel of stake frozen and honest for a month, so cheap copper-grade accounts earn nothing liquid, while one patient agent builds a basalt-solid record. Splitting into sockpuppets multiplies risk, not payout.
